index.a: Yes. Glass award orders start at 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards and sizes.

index.q: How long does an order take?
index.a: We confirm your price within 24 hours on working days (Monday to Friday). Orders are ready 10–14 working days after you approve our proof.

index.q: Do you supply trophies or medals?
index.a: No. For awards we only supply glass and crystal.

index.q: Can you engrave my watch or a single gift?
index.a: No. We don’t engrave personal items or gifts.

index.q: Do you have a shop I can visit?
index.a: No. We work from a private workshop and can’t take visits or collections. Everything is arranged by email, and every order is delivered to you.

index.q: Do you still make bench plaques?
index.a: Yes. We engrave memorial bench plaques in brass and stainless steel. Bench plaques have no minimum order.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: Can I put my own plaque on a council bench?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: Usually not. Most councils only allow plaques through their own dedication scheme, and unofficial plaques may be removed. Contact the council’s parks or bereavement team first.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: How many words fit on a bench plaque?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: It depends on the size. As a guide, a 6 x 4 inch plaque fits 4–5 lines and an 8 x 3 inch plaque 3–4 lines. We’ll always send a proof so you can see the spacing.
Yes. We regularly engrave in Welsh, English or both.
Yes. We can add a logo, crest or emblem in full colour or black and white. Send it as a PDF, EPS, SVG or a clear image.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: Do the plaques come with screws?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: Yes. Every bench plaque comes with stainless steel screws, so it won’t stain the wood.

memorial-bench-plaques.q: How long does a bench plaque take?
memorial-bench-plaques.a: Typically 10–14 working days from approval of your proof.
No. We can’t offer collections. Every plaque is posted to you with its fixings.

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: Can I put a plaque on any park bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: No. Park benches belong to the council, and most only allow plaques through their own dedication scheme. Unofficial plaques are usually removed.

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: How do I dedicate a bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: Contact the council or landowner’s parks or bereavement team. They’ll explain locations, costs and how long the dedication lasts.

can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.q: Can I put a plaque on my own bench?
can-i-put-a-plaque-on-a-bench.a: Yes. If the bench is yours, you can order a plaque directly from us in any size.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: What should I write on a memorial bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Most families choose a name, dates and one short line, such as “In loving memory of” or something about why the place mattered. Keep it to a few lines so the letters are large enough to read from the path.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: How many words fit on a bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: It depends on the size. As a guide, a 6 x 4 inch plaque fits 4–5 lines and an 8 x 3 inch plaque 3–4 lines. We’ll always send a proof so you can see the spacing.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can I put a poem or verse on a bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes, if it’s short. A two-line verse works well; a longer poem needs a bigger plaque and smaller letters. Send us the words and we’ll suggest a size.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can I put my dog’s name on a memorial bench plaque?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes, on your own bench or garden bench. On council benches the dedication scheme decides what’s allowed, so check with the parks team first.

bench-plaque-wording-ideas.q: Can you engrave the plaque in Welsh?
bench-plaque-wording-ideas.a: Yes. We regularly engrave in Welsh, English or both, with accents such as ŵ and ŷ.

plaque-fonts.q: Can I choose a different font?
plaque-fonts.a: Yes. We have many more engraving fonts than shown here. Tell us what you’d like and we’ll send a proof.

plaque-fonts.q: Can I mix fonts on one plaque?
plaque-fonts.a: Yes. A script name with Roman or capitals for the other lines is a popular choice.

plaque-fonts.q: Will my plaque look exactly like the preview?
plaque-fonts.a: Very close. The preview uses web fonts that match our engraving fonts, and we always send an exact proof before engraving.

plaque-fonts.q: Which font is easiest to read outdoors?
plaque-fonts.a: Classic Roman and Modern are the clearest from a distance, especially on stainless steel.

corporate-glass-awards.a: Glass award orders start at 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards and sizes. For memorial and bench plaques there’s no minimum.

Catalogue prices are per item. Engraving is £10.50 per position (e.g. the front) plus a flat £40 setup per order. They're guide prices and may change; bulk discounts may apply, confirmed in your quote.

corporate-glass-awards.q: Can you use our company logo?
corporate-glass-awards.a: Yes. Send it as a PDF, EPS or SVG and we’ll set it up for engraving.

corporate-glass-awards.q: How far ahead should we order?
corporate-glass-awards.a: We confirm your price within 24 hours (working days), and awards are ready 10–14 working days after you approve our proof. Allow at least 3–4 weeks before your event.

corporate-glass-awards.q: Can we reorder the same item next year?
corporate-glass-awards.a: Yes. We keep your artwork and specification on file, so repeat orders match exactly.

about.q: How long have Grimes Engravers been in business?
about.a: Since 1947. We’re a family-run business in Cardiff, now in our third generation.

award-wording-ideas.q: What should I write on an employee of the year award?
award-wording-ideas.a: Usually your logo, the event (for example “Staff Awards 2026”), the award title and the winner’s name. Add a short line such as the year or “in recognition of outstanding commitment” if there’s room.

award-wording-ideas.q: How much text fits on a glass award?
award-wording-ideas.a: It depends on the award. Every award page shows its engraving area, and as a rule four to six short lines look best. We send a free proof so you can see the layout before anything is engraved.

award-wording-ideas.q: Can every award in a set have different wording?
award-wording-ideas.a: Yes. Most sets keep the same logo and event and change the category and name on each award. Send us a list and we’ll proof each one.

award-wording-ideas.q: Can you engrave our company or club logo?
award-wording-ideas.a: Yes. Send it as a PDF, EPS or SVG and we’ll set it up for engraving.
Yes. Glass award orders start at 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards and sizes.

design-a-bench-plaque.q: How does the plaque designer work?
design-a-bench-plaque.a: Choose your wording, metal, size, font and options and you’ll see a preview as you go. Add it to your order and check out, and we’ll email the price within 24 hours (working days), then a free proof showing the exact layout before we engrave.

design-a-bench-plaque.q: Is there a minimum order for bench plaques?
design-a-bench-plaque.a: No. You can order a single bench plaque. Glass awards have a minimum of 2, but plaques don’t.

design-a-bench-plaque.q: Which size bench plaque should I choose?
design-a-bench-plaque.a: As a guide, an 8 x 3 inch plaque fits 3–4 lines and a 6 x 4 inch plaque 4–5 lines. The designer tells you if your wording would be small for the size you’ve picked. If the bench already has plaques, send a photo and we’ll match them.

design-a-bench-plaque.q: Do the plaques come with screws?
design-a-bench-plaque.a: Yes. Plaques with screw holes come with stainless steel screws, so they won’t stain the wood. You can also choose a self-adhesive backing with no holes, or no fixings at all if you’re fitting it another way.

design-a-bench-plaque.q: Can I add my own logo or emblem?
design-a-bench-plaque.a: Yes. Choose “My own logo or emblem” and reply to our email with the file (PDF, EPS, SVG or a clear photo). We engrave logos in black and white or full colour.

brass-bench-plaques.q: Will a brass bench plaque go dark?
brass-bench-plaques.a: Yes, over time. Brass naturally darkens outdoors unless it’s polished, and many families like the way it mellows. If you’d rather it stayed bright with no care, choose stainless steel.

brass-bench-plaques.q: How do I clean a brass plaque?
brass-bench-plaques.a: Use a little metal polish on a soft cloth, then buff it dry. Avoid scouring pads, which scratch the surface and the engraving.

brass-bench-plaques.q: What size brass plaque do I need?
brass-bench-plaques.a: An 8 x 3 inch plaque fits about 3–4 lines and a 6 x 4 inch plaque about 4–5 lines. The plaque designer shows how your wording fits each size.

brass-bench-plaques.q: Do brass plaques come with screws?
brass-bench-plaques.a: Yes. Plaques with screw holes come with stainless steel screws, so they won’t stain the wood.

stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Will a stainless steel plaque rust?
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: No. Stainless steel won’t rust or tarnish outdoors, which is why it’s often chosen for exposed and coastal spots.

stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Is stainless steel or brass better for a bench?
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: Both last well outdoors. Stainless steel stays silver with almost no care. Brass has a warmer, traditional look and darkens with age unless it’s polished.

stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: How do I clean a stainless steel plaque?
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: Wipe it with warm soapy water and a soft cloth, then dry it. That’s usually all it needs.

stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Do stainless steel plaques come with screws?
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: Yes. Plaques with screw holes come with stainless steel screws, so they won’t stain the wood.

pet-memorial-bench-plaques.q: What do you write on a pet memorial plaque?
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.a: Usually their name, a short line and the years, such as “For Max, our faithful friend, 2011 – 2025”. A favourite walk or spot makes it personal. See the examples above or our wording ideas page.

pet-memorial-bench-plaques.q: Can I add a paw print?
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.a: Yes. Choose the paw print or heart in the plaque designer, or send us your own emblem and we’ll show it on your proof.

pet-memorial-bench-plaques.q: Can I put a pet memorial plaque on a park bench?
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.a: Only if the bench owner allows it. Council bench schemes set their own rules about dedications, so check with them first. Garden and private benches are up to you.

pet-memorial-bench-plaques.q: Which size suits a pet memorial plaque?
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.a: An 8 x 3 inch plaque suits a name and a short line. For a longer message or a larger emblem, choose 6 x 4 inches or bigger.

memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.q: What do you write on a memorial plaque for mum or dad?
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.a: Most families choose their name and years with a short line, such as “In loving memory of our wonderful Mum” or “Who loved this view”. See the examples above or our full wording ideas.

memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.q: Can one plaque have both parents’ names?
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.a: Yes. Two names and dates fit comfortably on a 6 x 4 or 7 x 5 inch plaque, with a short line underneath.

memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.q: Can you match a plaque already on the bench?
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.a: Yes. Send us a photo of the existing plaque and we’ll match the metal, size and font as closely as we can.

memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.q: Can the plaque be in Welsh?
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.a: Yes. We engrave Welsh wording and accents correctly, in Welsh, English or both.

glass-vs-crystal-awards.q: Is crystal better than glass for awards?
glass-vs-crystal-awards.a: Optical crystal is clearer, heavier and costs more, so it suits headline awards, long service and retirements. Jade or clear glass looks smart for category and team awards at a lower price per award.
Jade glass is thick float glass with a natural green tint that shows on the polished edges. It engraves cleanly and costs less than optical crystal.

glass-vs-crystal-awards.q: Can both glass and crystal be engraved with a logo?
glass-vs-crystal-awards.a: Yes. Both are engraved with your logo and wording in a frosted white finish, and we send a proof before anything is engraved.

glass-vs-crystal-awards.q: Can we mix glass and crystal awards in one order?
glass-vs-crystal-awards.a: Yes. The minimum order is 2 awards in total, and you can mix different awards, materials and sizes.

awards-night-planning.q: How far ahead should we order awards for an awards night?
awards-night-planning.a: Allow at least 3–4 weeks before the event. We confirm your price within 24 hours on working days, and awards are ready 10–14 working days after you approve the proof.

awards-night-planning.q: How many award categories should an awards night have?
awards-night-planning.a: Most company awards nights have between 8 and 15 categories, so the evening keeps moving and each award still feels special.

awards-night-planning.q: We don’t know the winners yet. Can we still order?
awards-night-planning.a: Yes. Approve the award designs and categories now, then send the winners’ names when you have them.

awards-night-planning.q: Should every award be the same design?
awards-night-planning.a: Many companies use one design for category winners and a larger or more premium award for the headline prize, such as Employee of the Year.

bench-dedication-cost-wales.q: How much does it cost to dedicate a bench in Cardiff?
bench-dedication-cost-wales.a: Cardiff Bereavement Services charges £330 for a plaque on a shared bench and £1,000 for a personal seat with a plaque, each for a 10-year lease, in its cemeteries and crematoria. For benches in Cardiff parks, contact the council's parks team.

bench-dedication-cost-wales.q: Is a council bench dedication permanent?
bench-dedication-cost-wales.a: Usually not. Most schemes are a lease, often 10 years. At the end you can usually renew for a fee, or the plaque is removed and returned to you.

bench-dedication-cost-wales.q: Can I put my own plaque on a council bench?
bench-dedication-cost-wales.a: Usually not. Most councils supply and fit their own plaques, and plaques added without permission are removed. Check the council's scheme first.

bench-dedication-cost-wales.q: What is the cheapest way to dedicate a bench?
bench-dedication-cost-wales.a: A bench in your own garden, or at a club, church or school that agrees, with a plaque you order yourself. There is no lease to renew, and the plaque costs far less than a council scheme.

brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Does a brass bench plaque go green or dark?
brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: Brass outdoors gradually darkens to a soft brown patina. It can be polished back to a bright finish. The engraving stays readable either way.

brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Will a stainless steel plaque rust?
brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: No. Stainless steel is designed not to rust or tarnish, which makes it a good choice for coastal and exposed spots.

brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.q: Which lasts longer outdoors, brass or stainless steel?
brass-vs-stainless-steel-bench-plaques.a: Both last many years outdoors. Stainless steel keeps its look with almost no care; brass mellows with age unless it is polished.
Yes. Every plaque is pre-drilled and comes with stainless steel screws so it won't stain the wood.

glass-awards.q: What is the minimum order for engraved glass awards?
glass-awards.a: The minimum order is 2 awards in total. You can mix different awards, sizes and wording in one order.

glass-awards.q: How much do engraved glass awards cost?
glass-awards.a: Each award shows a 'from' price for the award itself. Engraving and delivery are added on top, and we email the full price within 24 hours on working days.

glass-awards.q: Can you engrave our company logo on glass awards?
glass-awards.a: Yes. Send your logo as a PDF, EPS or SVG if you have one, or a large clear image. We set it up for engraving and show it on a free proof before we start.

glass-awards.q: How long do engraved glass awards take?
glass-awards.a: Awards are ready 10 to 14 working days after you approve the proof. For an awards night, allow at least 3 to 4 weeks.

glass-awards.q: What is the difference between glass awards and glass trophies?
glass-awards.a: Nothing: people use both names for the same thing. We engrave glass and optical crystal awards (or trophies) in many shapes, including stars, columns, diamonds and awards on bases.
Yes. We engrave in Cardiff and deliver anywhere in the UK.

why-we-proof-first.q: Why don't I pay when I order?
why-we-proof-first.a: Because personalised items can't be sent back, we check every name and logo and send you a free proof first. Once you've approved it, we ask for a deposit or full payment by card or bank transfer before we engrave. Tick the box on the order page and we'll send a payment link with your proof.
We don't price match, because two awards that look alike online can be very different in quality. But we're always happy to talk through your budget and suggest options that work for you.

why-we-proof-first.q: What if my order arrives damaged?
why-we-proof-first.a: Send us a photo as soon as you can. We'll arrange a replacement and do everything we can to get it to you before your event.

why-we-proof-first.q: What if there's a mistake in the engraving?
why-we-proof-first.a: If it doesn't match the proof you approved, we'll re-engrave it at no cost. If the mistake was in the wording sent to us, talk to us anyway: we'll help, and do our best to meet your date.

why-we-proof-first.q: What if my event date changes?
why-we-proof-first.a: Just let us know. We'll work around your new date wherever we can.
